Common questions

Common UbyPort questions

Who must report foreign guests?

Accommodation providers in Czechia generally have to report accommodated foreign nationals to the Police of the Czech Republic. Business accommodation providers use the UbyPort internet application.

How soon must a foreign guest be reported?

The public authorities state a deadline of three working days after accommodation. Always follow the current official guidance for your situation.

Does UbyHost replace UbyPort registration?

No. First register the accommodation with UbyPort and request separate web-service credentials. UbyHost then uses those credentials to transmit records.

Does UbyHost import Airbnb and Booking.com reservations?

Yes. Their iCal feeds provide dates and availability. Guests provide the personal details through the private form.

Official information for accommodation providers

UbyHost is a technical tool, not legal advice. Check current duties with the Czech authorities.

Privacy first

Only what the law asks for. Nothing extra.

We store as little as we can, and say exactly what and for how long. Privacy policy

  1. 01

    Only the fields Czech law asks for

    The guest form asks for the guest-book and stay-fee details, plus an e-mail for the guest's private link.

  2. 02

    No tracking cookies

    Only the cookies that keep you signed in and protect your forms.

  3. 03

    No trackers in the app

    No ad or analytics scripts in the app or on guest pages. Website statistics run on public pages only, with PostHog Cloud EU.

  4. 04

    Passport photos deleted after check-in

    Optional and off by default. Deleted as soon as you verify the guest, otherwise automatically 7 days after check-in.
